name: ModMe Inbox — Code Snippet
description: AST-ready SoftwareSourceCode envelope for GitHub blobs/raw/gists and Cubic PR file views. Captures source from GitHub textarea (#read-only-cursor-text-area), not Defuddle {{content}}. True AST indexing stays in code-chunk.v1 / code-index.

properties.name: programming_language
properties.value: {% set ext = url|split:"/"|last|split:"?"|first|split:"."|last|lower %}{% if ext == "ts" or ext == "tsx" %}TypeScript{% elseif ext == "js" or ext == "mjs" or ext == "cjs" or ext == "jsx" %}JavaScript{% elseif ext == "rs" %}Rust{% elseif ext == "toml" %}TOML{% elseif ext == "py" %}Python{% elseif ext == "go" %}Go{% elseif ext == "java" %}Java{% elseif ext == "kt" %}Kotlin{% elseif ext == "rb" %}Ruby{% elseif ext == "php" %}PHP{% elseif ext == "cs" %}C#{% elseif ext == "cpp" or ext == "cc" or ext == "cxx" or ext == "h" or ext == "hpp" %}C++{% elseif ext == "c" %}C{% elseif ext == "swift" %}Swift{% elseif ext == "md" or ext == "mdx" %}Markdown{% elseif ext == "json" or ext == "jsonc" %}JSON{% elseif ext == "yml" or ext == "yaml" %}YAML{% elseif ext == "sql" %}SQL{% elseif ext == "sh" or ext == "bash" or ext == "ps1" %}Shell{% elseif ext == "css" %}CSS{% elseif ext == "html" or ext == "htm" %}HTML{% elseif ext == "vue" %}Vue{% elseif ext == "svelte" %}Svelte{% elseif ext == "prisma" %}Prisma{% else %}{{ext}}{% endif %}

properties.name: encoding_format
properties.value: {% set ext = url|split:"/"|last|split:"?"|first|split:"."|last|lower %}{% if ext == "ts" or ext == "tsx" %}text/typescript{% elseif ext == "js" or ext == "mjs" or ext == "cjs" or ext == "jsx" %}text/javascript{% elseif ext == "json" or ext == "jsonc" %}application/json{% elseif ext == "toml" %}application/toml{% elseif ext == "md" or ext == "mdx" %}text/markdown{% elseif ext == "html" or ext == "htm" %}text/html{% elseif ext == "css" %}text/css{% elseif ext == "yml" or ext == "yaml" %}application/yaml{% elseif ext == "py" %}text/x-python{% elseif ext == "rs" %}text/x-rust{% elseif ext == "go" %}text/x-go{% elseif ext == "sql" %}application/sql{% else %}text/plain{% endif %}

properties.name: code_repository
properties.value: {% if meta:octolytics-dimension-repository_nwo %}https://github.com/{{meta:octolytics-dimension-repository_nwo}}{% elseif domain contains "github.com" or domain contains "githubusercontent.com" %}{{url}}{% else %}{% endif %}

properties.name: raw_url
properties.value: {% if selector:a[data-testid="raw-button"]?href %}{{selector:a[data-testid="raw-button"]?href}}{% elseif selector:a[href*="/raw/"]?href %}{{selector:a[href*="/raw/"]?href}}{% elseif url contains "/blob/" %}{{url|replace:"/blob/":"/raw/"}}{% else %}{{url}}{% endif %}
